plan.title: Lab 11 quality-record final check uses unpublished exact tokens the lab page never names

narratives.Description: Lab 11 quality-record final check uses unpublished exact tokens the lab page never names
narratives.Overview:
## Situation

Lab 11 Task 4 says: update only `quality-record.json` to match the observed red, green, refactor, literal, forward-coverage, diagnosis, repair, and integrity evidence, then run `final`.

The starter file is:

```json
{
  "schema": "3ci.training.module11.quality-record.v1",
  "status": "INCOMPLETE",
  "evidence": {
    "red": "",
    "green": "",
    "refactor": "",
    "literalAcceptance": "",
    "forwardCoverage": "",
    "firstFailingSubcheck": "",
    "repair": "",
    "gateDefinitionsUnchanged": false
  }
}
```

The lab does not publish the required token values. The fixture verifier `labs/fixtures/11-testing-gates-and-evidence/scripts/verify-quality-record.mjs` deep-equals the whole object against:

- `status`: `COMPLETE`
- `red`: `EXPECTED_FAILURE`
- `green` / `refactor` / `literalAcceptance` / `forwardCoverage`: `PASS`
- `firstFailingSubcheck`: `quality:record`
- `repair`: `quality-record.json only`
- `gateDefinitionsUnchanged`: `true`

I completed the ordered stages on macOS/zsh against 0.119.5. Aggregate failed first at `quality:record` with `quality record is incomplete`. I then had to guess whether `red` should be the helper’s `EXPECTED_FAILURE` string, a prose description, or the focused-test exit `1`.

## Pain

A mid-level engineer following only the lab page will write evidence in their own words (`focused test exit 1`, `repaired the quality record`). `final` then fails with `quality record does not match the observed Module 11 evidence` even though the learner observed the right events.

The recovery table says “Compare the record with the six retained files.” Those files use mixed keys (`finalStatus`, `firstFailingSubcheck`, command output). They do not show the exact `repair` sentence `quality-record.json only`. That token exists in the explained solution and in the hidden verifier, not in the lab.

This turns a gate-integrity lesson into a secret-string exercise unless the learner opens the solution or reads the fixture script.

## Proposed fix

Print the required field tokens on the Lab 11 Task 4 page, next to the starter JSON. Example: copy `finalStatus` from each evidence file into the matching key; set `repair` to the literal `quality-record.json only`; set `firstFailingSubcheck` to `quality:record`.

Alternatively, have `final` compare semantically (status COMPLETE, first failing subcheck equals the retained aggregate field, gate hashes unchanged) instead of deep-equal against unpublished strings.

OS: macOS Darwin 25.6.0 arm64  
Shell: zsh 5.9  
Directive: 0.119.5  
Helper signal: aggregate `EXPECTED_FAILURE`, final `PASS` after using the solution tokens

The recut can bind as a Lab 11 page publication of the closed quality-record field tokens. It cannot bind as a copy-from-evidence-files procedure, and it cannot bind as a verifier rewrite.

## 1. Publish the closed field table, not a retained-file mapping

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence, re-run at `19f2b3dd829d089519a22cfeaba8d0bbd7fb9e23`:

- `labs/fixtures/11-testing-gates-and-evidence/scripts/verify-quality-record.mjs` `expectedQualityRecord` deep-equals `status: COMPLETE`, `red: EXPECTED_FAILURE`, `green` / `refactor` / `literalAcceptance` / `forwardCoverage: PASS`, `firstFailingSubcheck: quality:record`, `repair: quality-record.json only`, `gateDefinitionsUnchanged: true`.
- Token inventory of `labs/11-testing-gates-and-evidence.md`: `COMPLETE` 0, `quality-record.json only` 0, `literalAcceptance` 0, `forwardCoverage` 0, `firstFailingSubcheck` 0, `finalStatus` 0, `INCOMPLETE` 0. Task 4 names the file and the events, not those field values. The page does not print the starter JSON.
- `gates-lab.mjs` evidence writers use a different schema. `red.json` / `green.json` / `refactor.json` store `finalStatus`. `literal.json` stores `literalAcceptance` and `forwardCoverage` as command-result objects plus one `finalStatus: PASS`. `repair: quality-record.json only` is not written by any `writeEvidence` call. `lab-state.json` stage `COMPLETE` is set only inside `verifyFinal` after the aggregate already passed. At Task 4 fill time `final.json` does not exist.
- Hint 4 says "Copy evidence values, not gate commands." The recovery row for final quality mismatch says "Compare the record with the six retained files."
- Imported `verifyQualityRecord`: starter fails with `quality record is incomplete: expected status COMPLETE`. A `COMPLETE` record whose `repair` is `repaired the quality record` fails deep-equal on that one string.

Failure mode: an implementer who harvests the issue-body example ("copy `finalStatus` from each evidence file into the matching key") ships a procedure that cannot produce `repair` or split `literalAcceptance` / `forwardCoverage`, and leaves hint 4 plus the six-file recovery row teaching the same false mapping. Learners still fail `final` after doing what the page says.

Disposition: successor lean states the remaining work as Task 4 publishing the closed `expectedQualityRecord` field table (starter `INCOMPLETE` object plus required completed tokens). Same page slice recuts hint 4 and the final-mismatch recovery row to that table. Keep `scripts/verify-quality-record.mjs` frozen.

Existing mechanism: `solutions/lab-11-testing-gates-and-evidence.md` Step 6 already prints that object. Do not add a second record format.

## 2. Lock the lab page with the existing Module 11 content contract

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: `scripts/verify-module-11.mjs` already requires `EXPECTED_FAILURE`, `quality:record`, `quality-record.json only`, and `gateDefinitionsUnchanged` on the explained solution. Lab-page checks are helper verbs, evidence filenames, no-remote, and platform boundary. `node scripts/verify-module-11.mjs` exits 0 on this SHA while the lab page omits `COMPLETE` and `quality-record.json only`. Negative coverage lives in `scripts/verify-module-11.test.mjs`.

Failure mode: a one-line Task 4 edit can land and later drift; the current contract still reports ok.

Disposition: extend the existing lab-page phrase loop (and one negative mutation on `labs/11-testing-gates-and-evidence.md`) to require the closed token set on the lab page. Do not add a new verifier.

## 3. Page publication is the only remaining identity

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: `gates-lab.mjs` `immutableGateFiles` includes `scripts/verify-quality-record.mjs`. Helper copy is fingerprint-checked. Module 11 lesson: repair the work, not the gate. Issue body still offers a second identity: have `final` compare semantically instead of deep-equal.

Failure mode: harvest keeps both identities. An implementer edits the frozen quality verifier, which is the gate-weakening move this lab exists to forbid.

Disposition: drop the semantic-compare alternative from the next-build contract. Inventory already has the page, the solution blob, and the frozen `expectedQualityRecord`.

Road-not-taken: make the record a projection of retained evidence files. That would match "assemble from observed evidence" only after those files grew a shared schema and a `repair` field. What would flip this: take `verify-quality-record.mjs` out of `immutableGateFiles` under separate approved gate-maintenance scope. That is not this recut.

## 4. Seeded aggregate output names COMPLETE only

class: footnote

CLI `node scripts/verify-quality-record.mjs` on the starter prints `quality record is incomplete: expected status COMPLETE` and does not print `quality-record.json only`. A later wrong-but-COMPLETE record does print the full expected object in `error.message`. `runAggregate` stops on the seeded status failure, so `aggregate-failure.json` cannot carry the closed table. Do not treat a failed-`final` dump as the lab-page contract. `labs/README.md` still requires a lab not to depend on an unpublished file.

## 5. Stage prose already uses some helper strings

class: footnote

The lab page already prints `EXPECTED_FAILURE`, `PASS`, `quality:record`, and one `gateDefinitionsUnchanged: true` on `final.json`. Those are stage observations, not quality-record key bindings. Republishing them as if absent is noise; the missing work is the field table plus `COMPLETE` and `quality-record.json only`.

## Injection / swarm lens

N/A. The recut publishes documentation tokens on the Lab 11 page and extends an existing content-contract check. It does not change authority, untrusted input, prompts or envelopes, agent identity, concurrency, worktrees, or shared state.
